review_scope: Independent review of GL3-004 read-only exporter and GL3-005 local public-news collection, retained evidence, API, and UI. The verdict accepts this bounded local candidate only; it does not certify product launch or deployment.
evidence: Recomputed the candidate digest from 171 manifest entries and verified every listed file against its SHA-256; no mismatches.
Initial-to-final manifest comparison found only web/src/app/App.tsx, web/src/styles/app.css, and web/tests/first_path.spec.ts changed after backend validation.

Controller VALIDATION_INITIAL.json records backend lint, mypy, 62 passing tests, corrected isolated migration gate, live API proof, replay, browser test, build, and diff hygiene. VALIDATION.json records rerun frontend types/build, two browser tests, visual runtime, and diff hygiene for the final candidate.

Ignored live worker/API receipts show 105 RSS observations added across six publishers, 197 total observations and 198 evidence versions; replay left observation, evidence, project, power-need, change-event counts and Today digest unchanged. Existing needs stayed unchanged.

Code inspection confirms the publisher RSS branch stores Observation/Evidence and collection_only Interpretation without invoking project matching or qualification. It enforces response/item bounds, content type, unsafe XML and link rejection, date checks, duplicate handling, and no article-body retention.

Authenticated ingestion query provides stable pagination and source/vertical filters; cannabis watch is source-scoped, deterministic, and labeled for review. Mobile browser proof shows no horizontal overflow and pager follows the cards. The GL3-004 export is read-only, ordered, refuses overwrite, and preserves unmatched, active/inactive, and attributed evidence states.
limitations: The six publisher feeds expose latest rolling snapshots, so hourly local polling cannot guarantee catch-up after downtime or historical completeness.
Source scope is metadata, not an item's project geography; the three cannabis topic matches are not verified facility announcements or power opportunities.

The allowlist is trusted checked-in registry configuration and current URLs are the approved endpoints. Runtime RSS validation constrains HTTPS publisher hosts but does not pin each source ID to an exact path; this is a defense-in-depth follow-up if registry editing becomes an untrusted boundary.

The GL3-004 review sample is a retained-state baseline, not false-negative measurement or the PRD 30-Signal launch review. Cloud cycles, broader source families, commercial proof, and product finish gates remain open.
authority: No implementation, live database changes, push, merge, deployment, or external communication performed by reviewer.
